#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepared only. Root owns every build, benchmark, observer and process review."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from campaign_common import ROOT, REPO, PROJECTS, read, save, sha, utc, workloads

PREP = ROOT / 'preparation'
PLAN = PREP / 'campaign-plan.json'
FROZEN = PREP / 'frozen-runtime.json'
BUILD = PREP / 'root-runtime-build-receipt.json'
FORBIDDEN_ENV = ('JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS', 'JDK_JAVA_OPTIONS', '_JAVA_OPTIONS',
                 'JAVA_OPTS', 'GRADLE_OPTS', 'CLASSPATH')
SIGNALS = ('MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_START ', 'MEMORY_SNAPSHOT_END ', 'Memory snapshot failed',
           'Detected high memory usage:', 'Running low on memory', 'Ifds analysis timeout')

def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO), *args], text=True).strip()

def source_pins():
    names = git('ls-files', '-z', 'core', 'rules').split('\0')
    files = {p: sha(REPO / p) for p in names if p and (REPO / p).is_file() and
             ('/src/main/' in p or p.startswith('rules/') or
              p.endswith(('.gradle', '.gradle.kts', '.properties', '.toml', 'gradlew', '.jar')))}
    aggregate = hashlib.sha256(''.join(p + '\0' + h + '\n' for p, h in sorted(files.items())).encode()).hexdigest()
    return {'scope': 'Tracked production/rules/build/wrapper at selected clean commit',
            'files': files, 'aggregateSha256': aggregate}

def clean_revision(plan, revision):
    assert revision and revision == git('rev-parse', 'HEAD'), 'Root must select the actual current commit'
    assert revision not in plan['noRerunRevisions'], 'No old baseline/control rerun'
    subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO), 'diff', '--exit-code', revision, '--', 'core', 'rules'],
                   check=True, stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    assert not git('ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard', '--', 'core', 'rules'), 'Commit runtime/test inputs'
    for relative, expected in plan['expectedStorageSources'].items():
        assert sha(REPO / relative) == expected, 'Selected tested storage source changed: ' + relative
    assert sha(REPO / plan['unchangedPolicyPath']) == plan['unchangedPolicySHA256'], 'No new C2 policy is prepared'

def static_checks(plan):
    assert plan['state'] == 'NOT_READY_COMMITTED_STORAGE_RUNTIME_AND_ROOT_FREEZE_REQUIRED'
    assert plan['selectedRuntimeRevision'] is None and plan['runtimePins'] is None
    assert tuple(plan['projects']) == PROJECTS and not plan['baselineRerun']
    for relative, expected in plan['staticSourcePins'].items(): assert sha(REPO / relative) == expected, relative
    for path, expected in plan['externalPins'].items(): assert sha(path) == expected, path
    for path, expected in plan['helperPins'].items(): assert sha(ROOT / path) == expected, path
    for project in PROJECTS:
        cfg = plan['configs'][project]
        assert cfg['memory'] == '16g' and cfg['timeout'] == (1000 if project == 'OWASP' else 1080)
        assert cfg['outer_timeout'] == 1200 and sha(cfg['model']) == cfg['modelSha256']
        control = plan['selected4182Controls'][project]
        for key in ('manifest', 'summary'):
            assert sha(control[key]['path']) == control[key]['sha256']
    for controls in plan['references'].values():
        for control in controls.values():
            for relative, expected in control['files'].items():
                assert sha(Path(control['directory']) / relative) == expected['sha256'], relative
    assert subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', plan['testRepo'], 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip() == plan['testRevision']
    home = Path(plan['gradleUserHome'])
    initial = [p for p in (home / 'init.gradle', home / 'init.gradle.kts') if p.is_file()]
    if (home / 'init.d').is_dir(): initial += [p for p in (home / 'init.d').iterdir() if p.is_file()]
    assert sorted(str(p) for p in initial) == sorted(plan['globalGradleInitPins'])
    assert sorted(str(p) for p in (home / 'gradle.properties',) if p.is_file()) == sorted(plan['globalGradlePropertyPins'])
    for p, expected in dict(plan['globalGradleInitPins'], **plan['globalGradlePropertyPins']).items(): assert sha(p) == expected
    assert sha(Path(plan['observer']['javaHome']) / 'bin/java') == plan['javaExecutableSha256']
    assert sha(plan['observer']['asyncProfiler']) == plan['profilerBinarySha256']
    return {'state': 'STATIC_CONTROLS_VALID_NOT_READY', 'utc': utc(), 'processScanPerformed': False,
            'jobsStarted': False, 'diskFreeBytes': shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free}

def root_guard(plan, approved, disk_bytes):
    assert approved, 'Root alone runs this action after review'
    assert not any(os.environ.get(k) for k in FORBIDDEN_ENV), 'Use the exact clean root environment'
    assert os.environ.get('GRADLE_USER_HOME', str(Path.home() / '.gradle')) == plan['gradleUserHome']
    fields = {l.split(':', 1)[0]: int(l.split()[1]) * 1024 for l in Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines()
              if l.startswith('MemAvailable:')}
    assert fields['MemAvailable'] >= plan['minimumMemAvailableBytes'], 'Insufficient memory for fixed16GiB run'
    assert shutil.disk_usage(ROOT).free >= disk_bytes, 'Insufficient free capture space'
    live = workloads()
    assert not live, 'Wait for other analyzer/native/compiler/profile workers: ' + json.dumps(live)

def gate(plan):
    r = read(plan['nativeGateReceipt'])
    assert r['exitCode'] == 0
    totals = {k: sum(int(x[k]) for x in r['xml'].values()) for k in ('tests', 'failures', 'errors', 'skipped')}
    assert totals == {'tests': 3040, 'failures': 0, 'errors': 0, 'skipped': 0}, 'Require actual complete native gate'
    for relative, expected in r['sourceHashes'].items(): assert sha(REPO / relative) == expected, relative
    return {'path': plan['nativeGateReceipt'], 'sha256': sha(plan['nativeGateReceipt']), 'counts': totals,
            'qualification': '2578 fresh core results;462 reused successful JVM results in this receipt'}

def cp_snapshot(command):
    i = next(i for i, x in enumerate(command) if x in ('-cp', '-classpath', '--class-path'))
    result = []
    for name in command[i + 1].split(os.pathsep):
        p = Path(name)
        if p.is_file(): result.append({'path': name, 'kind': 'file', 'sha256': sha(p)})
        elif p.is_dir():
            files = sorted(q for q in p.rglob('*') if q.is_file())
            assert len(files) < 100000
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            for q in files: digest.update((str(q.relative_to(p)) + '\0' + sha(q) + '\n').encode())
            result.append({'path': name, 'kind': 'directory', 'fileCount': len(files), 'sha256': digest.hexdigest()})
        else: result.append({'path': name, 'kind': 'missing'})
    return result

def pid_stamp(pid):
    try: return Path('/proc/%s/stat' % pid).read_text().rsplit(')', 1)[1].split()[19]
    except OSError: return None

def environment(plan, registry):
    return dict(os.environ, JAVA_HOME=plan['observer']['javaHome'], GRADLE_USER_HOME=plan['gradleUserHome'],
                GRADLE_OPTS='-Dorg.gradle.daemon.registry.base=' + str(registry))

def build(plan, args):
    static_checks(plan); clean_revision(plan, args.revision); gate(plan)
    root_guard(plan, args.root_approved, plan['minimumInitialDiskBytes'])
    assert not BUILD.exists() and not (ROOT / 'runtime-build.console.log').exists()
    registry = ROOT / 'registries' / 'runtime-build'; assert not registry.exists()
    before = source_pins()
    command = ['./gradlew', ':classes', '--console=plain', '--no-daemon', '--max-workers=1', '--no-build-cache',
               '-Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx2g -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=2', '-Pkotlin.compiler.execution.strategy=in-process']
    receipt = {'state': 'RUNNING_ROOT_OWNED_BUILD', 'startedUTC': utc(), 'revision': args.revision,
               'command': command, 'cwd': str(REPO / 'core'), 'sourceAggregateBefore': before['aggregateSha256']}
    with (ROOT / 'runtime-build.console.log').open('x') as console:
        process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=REPO / 'core', env=environment(plan, registry),
                                   stdout=console, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        receipt.update(pid=process.pid, pidStartTick=pid_stamp(process.pid)); save(BUILD, receipt)
        code = process.wait()
    after = source_pins()
    receipt.update(state='COMMAND_ENDED', endedUTC=utc(), exitCode=code, sourceAggregateAfter=after['aggregateSha256'],
                   logSha256=sha(ROOT / 'runtime-build.console.log'))
    save(BUILD, receipt)
    assert code == 0 and before == after, 'Build failed or source changed; freeze is not allowed'

def freeze(plan, args):
    static_checks(plan); clean_revision(plan, args.revision)
    root_guard(plan, args.root_approved, plan['minimumInitialDiskBytes'])
    assert not FROZEN.exists() and not (PREP / 'launch-manifest.json').exists(), 'Freeze is single-use'
    native = gate(plan); build_receipt = read(BUILD)
    pins = source_pins()
    assert build_receipt['state'] == 'COMMAND_ENDED' and build_receipt['exitCode'] == 0
    assert build_receipt['revision'] == args.revision
    assert build_receipt['sourceAggregateBefore'] == build_receipt['sourceAggregateAfter'] == pins['aggregateSha256']
    template = read(ROOT / 'controls/conductor/analyzer-process.json')['command']
    current = cp_snapshot(template)
    original = read(plan['original4182ClasspathSnapshot'])['elements']
    old_missing = {x['path'] for x in original if x['kind'] == 'missing'}
    assert [x['path'] for x in current] == [x['path'] for x in original]
    assert {x['path'] for x in current if x['kind'] == 'missing'} <= old_missing, 'New missing runtime element'
    assert not any('overlay' in x['path'].lower() or '/preparation/' in x['path'] for x in current)
    assert (REPO / 'core/build/classes/kotlin/main/org/opentaint/jvm/sast/runner/ProjectAnalyzerRunner.class').is_file()
    save(PREP / 'launch-source-hashes.json', pins)
    save(PREP / 'runtime-classpath.json', {'elements': current, 'capturedAfterBuild': True,
         'originalMissingPathsAllowed': sorted(old_missing), 'noOverlay': True})
    providers = [x for x in current if any(s in x['path'] for s in ('/logback-', '/slf4j-api/'))]
    save(PREP / 'runtime-provider-pins.json', {'elements': providers, 'boundAfterCommit': args.revision})
    receipt = {'state': 'READY_ROOT_FROZEN_NOT_LAUNCHED', 'utc': utc(), 'revision': args.revision,
               'rootApproved': True, 'planSha256': sha(PLAN), 'sourceAggregateSha256': pins['aggregateSha256'],
               'nativeGate': native, 'runtimeBuildReceiptSha256': sha(BUILD),
               'runtimeClasspathSha256': sha(PREP / 'runtime-classpath.json'),
               'runtimeProviderPinsSha256': sha(PREP / 'runtime-provider-pins.json'), 'baselineRerun': False}
    save(FROZEN, receipt); print(receipt['state'], args.revision)

def frozen_checks(plan):
    static_checks(plan); f = read(FROZEN); assert f and f['state'] == 'READY_ROOT_FROZEN_NOT_LAUNCHED'
    assert f['planSha256'] == sha(PLAN); clean_revision(plan, f['revision'])
    assert source_pins() == read(PREP / 'launch-source-hashes.json')
    for name, key in [('runtime-classpath.json', 'runtimeClasspathSha256'), ('runtime-provider-pins.json', 'runtimeProviderPinsSha256')]:
        assert sha(PREP / name) == f[key]
    assert cp_snapshot(read(ROOT / 'controls/conductor/analyzer-process.json')['command']) == read(PREP / 'runtime-classpath.json')['elements']
    gate(plan); return f

class Controls:
    def __init__(self): self.pending = ''; self.discard = False
    def feed(self, chunk):
        pieces = chunk.split('\n')
        for i, part in enumerate(pieces):
            if not self.discard:
                if len(self.pending) + len(part) > 8192: self.pending = ''; self.discard = True
                else: self.pending += part
            if i == len(pieces) - 1: continue
            if not self.discard:
                message = self.pending.partition(' - ')[2] or self.pending
                if message.startswith(SIGNALS + ('BIDI_RUN_START ', 'BIDI_RUN_END ', 'BIDI_ANALYSIS_END ')) or re.match(r'(?:Exception in thread .+ )?java\.lang\.OutOfMemoryError(?:[:\s]|$)', message): yield message
            self.pending = ''; self.discard = False

def launch(plan, args):
    frozen = frozen_checks(plan); root_guard(plan, args.root_approved, plan['minimumInitialDiskBytes'])
    path = PREP / 'launch-manifest.json'; assert not path.exists()
    assert not any((ROOT / 'projects' / p / 'bidi').exists() for p in PROJECTS)
    expected = read(PREP / 'expected-project-manifests.json')
    receipt = {'state': 'RUNNING_ROOT_OWNED', 'startedUTC': utc(), 'rootApproved': True,
               'revision': frozen['revision'], 'frozenRuntimeSha256': sha(FROZEN), 'projects': {}, 'baselineRerun': False}
    receipt.update(launcherPid=os.getpid(), launcherStartTick=pid_stamp(os.getpid()))
    (ROOT / 'campaign.pid').write_text(str(os.getpid()) + '\n')
    save(path, receipt); events = []
    try:
        for project in PROJECTS:
            frozen_checks(plan); root_guard(plan, args.root_approved, plan['minimumProjectDiskBytes'])
            control = plan['selected4182Controls'][project]; registry = Path(control['registryBase'])
            assert not registry.exists(), 'Per-project registry must be fresh'
            directory = ROOT / 'projects' / project / 'bidi'
            assert not directory.exists(), 'Never overwrite any project attempt'
            state = {'state': 'RUNNING', 'startedUTC': utc(), 'command': control['command'],
                     'allowedGradleOpts': control['allowedGradleOpts'], 'registryBase': str(registry)}
            reader = Controls(); offset = 0; latest = None
            with (ROOT / (project + '.benchmark.console.log')).open('x') as console:
                process = subprocess.Popen(control['command'], cwd=REPO, env=environment(plan, registry),
                    stdout=console, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
                state.update(pid=process.pid, pidStartTick=pid_stamp(process.pid))
                receipt['projects'][project] = state; save(path, receipt)
                def poll():
                    nonlocal offset, latest
                    log = directory / 'analyzer.log'
                    if not log.is_file(): return
                    with log.open(errors='replace') as stream:
                        stream.seek(offset)
                        for chunk in iter(lambda: stream.read(65536), ''):
                            for message in reader.feed(chunk):
                                marker = re.match(r'BIDI_RUN_(?:START|END) run=([1-9][0-9]*) ', message)
                                if marker: latest = 'run-' + marker[1]
                                if message.startswith(SIGNALS) or 'java.lang.OutOfMemoryError' in message:
                                    events.append({'project': project, 'utc': utc(), 'latestReached': latest, 'message': message})
                        offset = stream.tell()
                    save(PREP / 'heap-capture-receipts.json', {'state': 'RUNNING', 'events': events,
                         'policy': 'Native guard capture before cancellation; watcher never requests a second heap'})
                while process.poll() is None: poll(); time.sleep(1)
                poll(); code = process.wait()
            state.update(state='COMMAND_ENDED', endedUTC=utc(), benchmarkReturnCode=code)
            actual = read(directory / 'manifest.json'); summary = read(directory / 'summary.json')
            assert actual and summary, 'Benchmark failed before its terminal metadata; retain attempt and review'
            for key, value in expected[project].items(): assert actual[key] == value, 'Changed analyzer control: ' + project + '/' + key
            assert actual['revision'] == frozen['revision']
            metadata = read(directory / 'analyzer-process.json'); assert metadata, 'No actual analyzer provenance'
            argv = metadata['command']
            previous = read(ROOT / 'controls' / project / 'analyzer-process.json')['command']
            expected_argv = [x.replace(control['directory'], str(directory)) for x in previous]
            assert argv == expected_argv, 'Actual analyzer argv differs from4182 beyond output paths'
            assert not any('org.gradle.daemon.registry.base' in x for x in argv), 'Registry property leaked to analyzer'
            assert cp_snapshot(argv) == read(PREP / 'runtime-classpath.json')['elements'], 'Analyzer classpath changed'
            assert (registry / '8.10/registry.bin').is_file(), 'Isolated registry was not observed'
            state.update(summary=summary, isolatedRegistryObserved=True, analyzerClasspathVerified=True,
                         argvEqualTo4182ExceptOutputPath=True, noRegistryOptionInAnalyzer=True,
                         actualAnalyzerProcessSha256=sha(directory / 'analyzer-process.json'))
            save(path, receipt)
            assert code == 0, 'Benchmark wrapper failed; preserve terminal evidence for review'
        heaps = [{'project': project, 'path': str(p), 'bytes': p.stat().st_size}
                 for project in PROJECTS for p in (ROOT / 'projects' / project / 'bidi').glob('*.hprof')]
        save(PREP / 'heap-capture-receipts.json', {'state': 'ALL_FOUR_COMMANDS_ENDED', 'events': events,
             'snapshots': heaps, 'noHeapExpectedWithoutOOM': True, 'heavyHeapProcessingStarted': False})
        receipt.update(state='COMMAND_ENDED', endedUTC=utc(), allFourTerminal=True)
    except BaseException as error:
        receipt.update(state='REVIEW_REQUIRED', reviewUTC=utc(), error=str(error), allFourTerminal=False)
        save(path, receipt); raise
    save(path, receipt); print('ALL_FOUR_COMMANDS_ENDED')

def review_stop():
    receipt = read(PREP / 'launch-manifest.json', {})
    result = {'state': 'REVIEW_ONLY_NO_SIGNAL', 'utc': utc(), 'campaignState': receipt.get('state'), 'projects': []}
    for project, state in receipt.get('projects', {}).items():
        pid = state.get('pid'); row = {'project': project, 'benchmarkPid': pid, 'savedState': state['state'],
             'benchmarkStartTickMatches': pid_stamp(pid) == state.get('pidStartTick') if pid else False}
        try: row['benchmarkArgv'] = Path('/proc/%s/cmdline' % pid).read_bytes().replace(b'\0', b' ').decode()
        except OSError: row['benchmarkArgv'] = None
        row['analyzerMetadata'] = read(ROOT / 'projects' / project / 'bidi/analyzer-process.json')
        result['projects'].append(row)
    print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('action', choices=('check-static', 'build', 'freeze', 'preflight', 'launch', 'review-stop'))
    parser.add_argument('--revision'); parser.add_argument('--root-approved', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args(); plan = read(PLAN)
    if args.action == 'check-static': print(json.dumps(static_checks(plan), indent=2))
    elif args.action == 'build': build(plan, args)
    elif args.action == 'freeze': freeze(plan, args)
    elif args.action == 'preflight':
        frozen_checks(plan); root_guard(plan, args.root_approved, plan['minimumInitialDiskBytes']); print('READY_ROOT_FROZEN_NOT_LAUNCHED')
    elif args.action == 'launch': launch(plan, args)
    else: review_stop()

if __name__ == '__main__': main()
